title: Normalized quest definition (legacy goals domain)
description: Contract for one normalized quest: one stored legacy goals entry. Native integer id and reward are kept verbatim (rule Q3); title, description, and hint are strings with the uniformly-empty hint preserved (rule Q3). See packages/game-content/README.md for the rule set and survey citations.

legacy_id.description: Stored goals id preserved verbatim as a string (rule Q4): the decimal form of the native integer id.

kind.description: Classification of the stored goals domain: every goals entry maps to quest.

source_file.description: Origin file of the stored entry: config/main.json (no patch targets goals).

source_layer.description: Layering origin: stored (no patch targets goals).

content_version.description: Content fingerprint (sha256 over the stored source bytes plus the mods list); sources carry no version stamp.

id.description: Native stored goals id, kept verbatim (rule Q3).

hint.description: Quest hint, preserved verbatim; empty in all 91 stored entries (rule Q3, uniformity noted in the manifest).

reward.description: Quest reward, preserved verbatim; uniformly 10 in all 91 stored entries (rule Q3, uniformity noted in the manifest).
